purpose: Two requirements hidden inside the responsibilities paragraph ('so you have operated Kubernetes in production before and you write Go every week'), a short 'You have' list, a preferred sentence without a nice-to-have heading ('It helps if…'), responsibilities that name tools (Terraform, Prometheus) which are also requirements elsewhere, and an on-call rotation that is a condition of the job rather than a qualification.

requirements.why: The responsibilities paragraph demands prior Kubernetes production experience in so many words.
Same sentence: 'you write Go every week'.
'It helps if' is the posting's framing of preferred.
POSTING COUNT: Kubernetes in production, Go, 5+ years infra/platform/SRE, Terraform or Pulumi.
